jobs.prompt: Bump the version from 1.165.1 to 1.166.0. In package.json and package-lock.json (both places in the lock: the top version and packages[""].version) change 1.165.1 to 1.166.0. In README.md change every 1.165.1 pin (kickoff text, tag name) to 1.166.0. In these tests replace the 1.165.1 pin with 1.166.0 where it is the current-version pin (assertions, test titles, the pin map in the AH release test): tests/t101-release.test.mjs, tests/field-lesson-t80-cli.test.mjs, tests/field-lessons-batch-x.test.mjs, tests/field-lessons-batch-ab-release.test.mjs, tests/field-lessons-batch-ag-release.test.mjs, tests/field-lessons-batch-ah-release.test.mjs. In CHANGELOG.md add a NEW top entry ## 1.166.0 above the 1.165.1 entry (keep it unchanged) with the lead-in line: Safer restarts, autonomous manifest review, partial-run retry and fixes from the parts-app field report. And these bullets with a bold lead word like the 1.165.0 entry: Update: a live restart lock is never stolen, the server record stores its runner path so servers started from any install path are restarted, and a held autopilot is not counted busy by update --when-idle. | Integrate: a partly blocked run stays integrable; the retry integrates only the remaining jobs. | Manifests: workflow and dependency files are reviewed by an independent model against a safe-rules list; a pass auto-approves that exact hash under the policy and logs it; the producing session can never approve its own manifest. | Autopilot: read-only runs count as integrated and never raise integrate blockers; a failed run already re-run by hand is not retried (swarm resolve RUN --handled); quiet polls write nothing. | Dependency gate: a package.json change that touches no dependency field and no install script skips the audit. | Guard: free text in notes, asks, tickets and commit messages never trips the hand-build guard; refusals name the rule and the matched token. | Failure regression: new failure causes become regression test stubs at run end (profile option failureRegression, off by default). Change nothing else. Run the six listed test files; all must pass. ignoreTests reason: only version pins and the changelog change; the fixture ledger is a frozen data copy.
